name: Beast of Bray Road
description: A wolf-like, sometimes-bipedal cryptid reported near Elkhorn, Walworth County, Wisconsin, beginning in the late 1980s. Investigated and popularized by reporter Linda Godfrey, who later argued it is part of a wider 'manwolf' or 'dogman' phenomenon across the Midwest.
origin: Reports center on rural Walworth County, Wisconsin (the Elkhorn / Lake Geneva area), with related 'manwolf' or 'dogman' reports across Wisconsin and the broader Upper Midwest.
